subject: Orbit Consulting — Tech acceptance & staging checklist
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Cho <aaron.cho@orbit.consulting>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Orbit — tech acceptance and staging checklist

Aaron —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our follow-up, Orbit's team wanted an explicit acceptance criteria and a staging test plan before we sign off the integration SOW. I put together a short checklist and a proposed test matrix so both eng teams can validate feature parity and perf behavior in a Redwood private staging environment.

High level ask: can Orbit review the attached reference design and the test matrix, confirm any missing scenarios, and nominate the two engineering contacts who will run the tests on your side?

Attachments: redwood-orbit-reference-design-v1.pdf (PDF, 520KB); orbit-staging-test-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)

Proposed next steps:
- Orbit reviews documents (this week)
- Align on staging window and test ownership
- Redwood provisions private staging (VPC) and shares credentials + runbook
- Run acceptance tests, collect perf logs, and review results together

If that works, I can schedule a 45-minute handoff on Tuesday to walk through the matrix.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0129

From: Aaron Cho <aaron.cho@orbit.consulting>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya@orbit.consulting>, eng@orbit.consulting
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Orbit — tech acceptance and staging checklist

Marissa —

Thanks for sending these over. The reference design looks good at a glance. Quick callouts from our infra lead (Priya):
- We'll need a brief schema mapping doc for the payloads (events -> Redwood inference API)
- We want operator-level logs (token-level latency samples) exposed to our side during the window
- Can you confirm the quantization variant you'll run in staging (int8 vs int4), and whether KV-cache warmup will be included in the perf runs?

Our primary test owners will be Priya Nair (priya@orbit.consulting) and Kevin Li (kevin.li@orbit.consulting, cc'd on eng alias). They can join the Tuesday handoff.

Aaron
Director, Solutions Engineering
Orbit Consulting
aaron.cho@orbit.consulting

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Orbit — tech acceptance and staging checklist

Team — forwarding Orbit's reply. Action items for internal prep before the handoff:

1) Jonas, please produce the payload schema mapping snippet and add a short example (request/response) to the shared Drive folder. Aim: show required fields and the expected error modes.
2) Sergio, can you confirm the quantization profile we'll use in the private staging pool and whether we can toggle int8/int4 per-test? Also confirm KV-cache warmup steps and if we should include a 30s warmup window for steady-state measurements.
3) Laura, I'll need a short runbook (2 pages) for provisioning VPC staging credentials and temporary role scoping. Keep it customer-friendly — Orbit will follow it during the window.

Tentative schedule: Tue 2026-12-01 11:00 PT for a 45-minute handoff with Orbit. I'll send the invite once the team's ready.

Thanks —
Marissa

Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2026 14:40:00 -0800
Subject: Orbit — staging window confirmed + acceptance checklist (docs attached)

Aaron/Priya/Kevin —

Thanks for confirming owners. Quick update from our side:

- Jonas uploaded the payload schema and examples to the shared Drive link (see below).
- Sergio confirmed we'll run int8 quantized variants by default and will also run a short int4 comparison pass; KV-cache warmup will be included with a 30s warmup prior to steady-state measurement.
- Laura attached the provisioning runbook for VPC creds and temporary role scoping.

I've attached a consolidated acceptance checklist and the final test matrix. Please review sections marked "Scope decision required" — those are the scenarios we expect Orbit to confirm before the window.

Staging window: Thu 2026-12-03 01:00–05:00 PT (preliminary). We'll provision the private staging cluster 24 hours prior; please confirm availability for a quick sync 30 minutes before start.

Attachments: orbit-staging-test-matrix.xlsx; redwood-orbit-reference-design-v1.pdf; sow-orbit-redwood-draft.docx

Related links:
- Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/0B-orbit-staging-plan
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 (D-98432)

Please reply with any outstanding scope items. If none, we will consider this aligned and proceed to schedule provisioning.

Best —
